title: psyllium scabrum
intro: Psyllium scabrum, commonly known as Bladder Wrack, is a type of brown seaweed that belongs to the family Fucaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including aiding in digestion, reducing inflammation, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Psyllium scabrum include demulcent, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it effective in treating conditions such as bronchitis, cough, and sore throat. The bioactive constituents of Psyllium scabrum include fucoidan, alginic acid, and iodine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
